answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity earns rewards only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties, each a separate vertex; a self-trading cluster fails. A violet mark follows a prism check splitting partners by time, sector and region, so renamed copies cannot fake diversity. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 real partners at 20 units bond each, costing 24,000 units. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
